detours.why: Johnson & Hardwick's only mapped access is its Broad Street front, so the walk to the Architecture Building behind it goes round the block by Norris Street.

notes.morgan-hall: Pinned on Morgan Hall North (OSM way/335244610) at its Broad Street and Cecil B. Moore Avenue corner; OSM splits Morgan Hall into North and South towers, so the name rule found two buildings.
notes.howard-gittis-student-center: The Howard Gittis Student Center holds the campus food court (Temple dining); the meal-plan dining halls sit inside Morgan Hall and Johnson & Hardwick, which are halls here.
notes.liacouras-center: The Liacouras Center is Temple's basketball and events arena (OSM way/540537145), not a student gym or a class building.
notes.temple-university-aramark-student-traini: The Aramark STAR Complex is the varsity teams' practice facility and fields (OSM way/543968021), not a student gym or a class building.
notes.student-pavilion: The Student Pavilion is Campus Recreation's indoor turf for club and intramural sports (OSM way/192992781), not a class building or a fitness gym.
notes.paley-hall-786344433: A second OSM outline (way/786344433) of Paley Hall, already listed as paley-hall from way/134472802.
notes.the-shops-at-north-avenue: Retail row on Broad Street (OSM way/134472711). Not somewhere undergraduates have class.
notes.paul-l-dunbar-school: Paul L. Dunbar School is a School District of Philadelphia K-8 school (OSM way/337289220), not a Temple building.
notes.1926-1938-n-liacouras-walk: An address-only OSM name (way/682746086) for row houses on Liacouras Walk, with no Temple building name.
notes.oxford-village: Oxford Village is a private student apartment complex (OSM way/962235472). Housing, not class.
notes.oxford-village-962235473: Second building of the private Oxford Village apartments (OSM way/962235473). Housing, not class.
notes.bell-tower: The Bell Tower is a landmark on Beury Beach (OSM way/786344424), not a building with classrooms.
